sources.schematic: hardware/v8schematics/v8h/tinyGv8h - schematic page1.pdf (sheet 1, CPU section): J7 'XY switches', J8 'ZA switches', R10-R17, C43-C50
sources.wiki: .analysis/docs/tinyg-wiki/Homing-and-Limits-Description-and-Operation.md: 8 switch inputs on terminal blocks J7 and J8, with two ground and two 3.3 V terminals

input.note: Every switch line has a 2.7 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V (R10-R17) and 0.22 µF to GND (C43-C50) at the terminal, plus the xmega's internal pull-up. A released line rises with τ ≈ 0.6 ms, so edges closer than about 1 ms are smoothed before the xmega sees them. An unpowered TinyG turns the pull-ups into a load towards its dead 3.3 V rail.
